# Catalog QA

Read DEVELOPMENT_STANDARDS.md first. Own only reproducible startup, accessibility, controls, objectives, scores, save, replay, regression, and platform catalog testing. Inspect the exact parent candidate and canonical main. Select one bounded defect and produce a failing test before repair, passing test afterward, independently extracted artifact verification and a concise evidence log. Never claim that script loading proves a full campaign works. Preserve all Cyber Wars code and isolated flagship development. Do not merge to main or deploy. Escalate release qualifications to the independent release gate.

## Handoff contract
Record exact parent repo SHA and any source candidate hash; one bounded objective; owned paths; changed files; reproducible failing/passing tests; environment/limitations; code vs asset rights; rebase status; next specialist. Use a draft PR; never approve/merge your own work, disable CI or deploy.
